rca_of_issue: Service card navigation issue: The service cards in services.tsx have testID and onPress handler with router.push(`/service/${svc.id}`), but clicking the card doesn't navigate to the detail screen. Possible causes: (1) TouchableOpacity event not firing, (2) router.push not working for dynamic routes, (3) Expo Router navigation issue with [id] parameter. The service detail screen file exists at /app/frontend/app/service/[id].tsx and the API endpoint works (GET /api/services/{id} returns 200). Reproduction: Login → Services tab → Click any service card → No navigation occurs, stays on services list.
